template.description: name of the Template used by the collection configuration

category.description: name of the Category (optional value attached to a collection configuration)

targets.description: array of Target IDs used in this collection configuration

computers.description: array of Computer GUIDs used in this collection configuration

hasInputs.description: true if any input paths exist within the targets or computers specified in this collection configuration

tasks.description: array of Tasks used in this collection configuration

type.description:
One of `From` or `Last`.

`From` specifies absolute start/end dates.

`Last` specifies last number of days back from the current date

useGMT.description: `true` specifies GMT for time, `false` specifies local time

startDate.description: inclusive start date in the format `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss` (only used if type = `From`)

endDate.description: inclusive end date in the format `yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss` (only used if type = `From`)

numDays.description: number of days back from the current date (only used if type = `Last`)

checkCreation.description: When `true`, apply date criteria to creation date

checkModification.description: When `true` apply date criteria to modification date

checkAccess.description: When `true`, apply date criteria to access date

destination.description: destination where evidence is to be saved

credentials.description: Set to `true` if credentials are supplied to access the destination

createFileSafe.description: Set to `true` to create a FileSafe, `false` save native copies of the files

compression.description: Compression setting for saved data.  One of `None`, `Medium`, `High` (used only if createFileSafe = `true`)

segmentSize.description: size of each FileSafe segment (used only if createFileSafe = `true`)

segmentSizeUnit.description: unit of measure which applies to segmentSize.  One of `KB`, `MB`, or `GB` (used only if createFileSafe = `true`)

overwrite.description: whether to overwrite existing files at the destination (used only if createFileSafe = `false`)

maintainFullPath.description: whether to maintain the full path of the file at the destination (used only if createFieSafe = false)

validateCollection.description: whether to validate the entire FileSafe after collection is completed

extension.description: file type extension (do not include the preceding dot)

collectAll.description: If `true`, collect this file type regardless of keyword search

FileType.description: describes the file type filters used in the collection (this object is optional)

analyzeSignatures.description: when `true`, read the beginning of each file to determine file type.  When `false` use filename extension only to determine file type.

mode.description: One of `Include` or `Exclude` - include or exclude the file types listed in the `extensions` array

extensions.description: array of one or more file type extensions

fileSize.description:
Optional file size.

If provided, will be used to match before calculating hash

microHash.description:
Optional MD5 hash value of the first 64 KB of a file.

Used to match before calculating a full hash

expressionName.description: human-readable description of the search expression

caseSensitive.description: When `true` specifies the search should be case-sensitive

regExpression.description: When `true` specifies the `expression` is interpreted as a Regular Expression

taskNum.description: 0-based index of tasks (jobs) to be run in this collection configuration

label.description:
user-defined label for this job.

Can be used as search criteria for jobs

impersonation.description: The enumeration value `None` or `Logged on User`

taskType.description:
The type of task.  One of `Collect`, `Relocate`, `Deploy` or `Launch`.
This value will determine which fields follow.

dates.description: array of one or more date criteria

hashes.description: array of hash values used to identify files to be collected

collectVolatile.description: Whether to collect volatile information,  When `false` the remaining fields are ignored

collectHandles.description: Whether to collect handles as part of the collection (collectVolatile must be `true`)

collectionScreenShots.description: Whether to capture screen shots of all windows (requires impersonation, collectVolatile must be `true`)

screenShotFormat.description: The graphic file format to save screen shot images.  One of `PNG` or `JPG` (collectScreenShots must be `true`)

collectRAM.description: When `true` saves a bit-for-bit image of the RAM

SmartMover.description: For a `Deploy` or `Relocate` task.  Specifies the copying or moving of files from one ECC Client to another

destinationFolder.description: folder on the destination computer where evidence is to be copied

moveOrCopy.description:
`Move` or `Copy`.

Either setting will copy files to the destination computer.  `Move` will delete evidence from the source after the copy is complete.
